title: Chapter 349 Heading To Yingying Town
content:
Chapter 349 Heading To Yingying Town

Before this, his cultivation was mainly to improve his level, but here, the concept of level has disappeared.

Because this place cannot be digitized.

And through observation, they release skills more smoothly than himself, without the concept of CD.

It seems that if he wants to achieve their level, he must also digitize.

After a simple rest, everyone went their separate ways.

Wang Shuo did not accept the invitation of Swan and Song Bo and others to return to Yingying Town together.

Instead, he left alone.

After knowing the function of the demon pill, Wang Shuo wanted to kill more demon beasts.

Moreover, they dismembered the main materials of the demon beasts and put them into a huge backpack.

It is obvious that they probably don’t have space equipment.

It is even more inconvenient for Wang Shuo to act with them.

If they suddenly form a group on the way, he may not be able to resist.

After parting, Wang Shuo rode Da Huang and left quickly.

At the same time, on the way back, some simple obstacles were set up. As long as someone passed by, these obstacles would change and even make a sound.

Wang Shuo put away Da Huang, then climbed up a big tree and hid.

He wanted to try whether these two groups of people would follow him.

After waiting for an hour, no one passed by on the road.

During this period, only a thumb-sized flower snake caught a squirrel nearby.

It relieved Wang Shuo's boredom.

Just when Wang Shuo was about to come down from the tree, there was a noise in the distance.

Wang Shuo held his breath.

Sure enough, Song Bo and his two younger brothers came over.

Wang Shuo's heart sank.

Strangers are really not trustworthy.

Wang Shuo thought about it carefully and was not sure about dealing with three people.

He still had too few cards now.

If Li Jianguo's crossbow battalion was second, Wang Shuo would have shot these people into slag.

Of course, it was too bullying for him to deal with three people with just one battalion.

Wang Shuo didn't want to fight with them, so he could only stay still and didn't dare to make any noise.

When several people walked over, Wang Shuo still remained motionless.

After a while, Wang Shuo had to sigh at his own caution.

Song Bo and his two companions returned.

A few minutes later, the three of them left again.

After waiting for more than ten minutes, Wang Shuo decisively came down from the tree.

He left in the opposite direction.

Wang Shuo secretly remembered these people in his heart. If he had the chance, he would definitely kill them.

Wang Shuo did not plan to go back to the temporary shelter he built.

In the dense forest, with Da Huang by his side, Wang Shuo moved more easily.

Two days later.

Wang Shuo came to a black light gate.

In the past two days, he had experienced several dangers and encountered three dark gold-level bosses.

In theory, top-level generals are qualified to fight dark gold bosses alone.

But Wang Shuo tried it and had to escape in disgrace.

He also encountered four gold bosses, and Wang Shuo was not polite and took them down directly.

Near the black portal, after observing for a while, Wang Shuo decisively walked over.

After stepping into the light gate.

In a blink of an eye, Wang Shuo came to a teleportation square.

At this time, people kept teleporting over.

Since it was a short-distance teleportation, Wang Shuo did not feel dizzy.

He looked up.

The town was dark all around, but the sky was bright inside.

Obviously, this was caused by the formation.

Wang Shuo was no longer surprised.

Yingying Town had 6 such teleportation formations, corresponding to hundreds of teleportation gates in the wild.

To facilitate the generals to come back at any time.
